plan.title: Scholarship Scheme Progress by District
plan.subtitle: An overview of pending scholarship applications across different districts.

panels.title: Total Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Pending Applications by District
panels.sql: SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 Districts with Most Applications
panels.sql: SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS application_count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This page provides a snapshot of scholarship application progress across various districts. The total number of applications received is {{p1}}.  {{p2}} shows the number of pending applications in each district, highlighting areas requiring attention.  {{p3}} details the districts with the highest volume of applications, offering insights into demand.
